# Examples cards keep at most one detail panel expanded

## Context

Operator-reported live defect on the `/examples` overview (`Start here`) and group pages: two example cards (`Community Garden Plan` and `Sprint Board`) easily remain expanded simultaneously, and once a card such as `Sprint Board` is clicked, its `.portal-example-more` detail section stays permanently expanded even when walking across cards with Arrow keys or hovering other cards with the mouse.

## The Problem

Three interacting rules in `Portal.view.examples.List` (`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs`) and `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css` allow multiple cards to expand at once and latch clicked cards open indefinitely on desktop:

1. **Desktop `.neo-selected` latches a clicked card open permanently (`List.css:158-163`, `ListModel.mjs:67-82`):**
   - `Portal.view.examples.List` inherits `disableSelection: false` and `selectOnFocus: false` from `Neo.list.Base`.
   - Clicking anywhere on a card—including clicking its title or `Open live ↗` link (`target="_blank"`)—triggers `ListModel#onListClick` and adds `.neo-selected` to `<li class="neo-list-item">`.
   - Because `.neo-list-item.neo-selected { .portal-example-more { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } }` in `List.css:159` is unscoped instead of restricted to touch/phone viewports (`@media (max-width: 600px), (hover: none)`), and because Arrow-key navigation (`selectOnFocus: false`) moves DOM focus without moving `.neo-selected` while `singleSelect: true` never deselects on re-click or mouse leave, that card stays expanded forever on desktop.
2. **Mouse-click `:focus-within` keeps a clicked card open after the pointer leaves (`List.css:158`):**
   - `:focus-within` matches mouse-click focus on `<li tabindex="-1">` and `<a class="neo-title">`, keeping a clicked card expanded even after the pointer leaves the list, whereas `:focus-visible` / `:has(:focus-visible)` activates only on keyboard modality (`Tab`, `Arrow` keys).
3. **Simultaneous `:hover` and keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) expand two cards at once (`List.css:158-174`):**
   - Hovering Card B while Card A holds keyboard focus expands both cards unless hover and keyboard focus yield to whichever input modality acted last (pointer `mouseenter` vs keyboard `Tab` / `Arrow` navigation).
   - On touch/phone viewports (`max-width: 600px` / `hover: none`), tapping an `<a>` launch link should also avoid latching `.neo-selected`, and tapping an already-open card body should toggle `.neo-selected` closed so a single card is never irrevokably open there either.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs` (`Portal.view.examples.List`, extending `Neo.list.Base`) and `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css` own card rendering and `.portal-example-more` disclosure across `Overview`, `GroupPage`, and `SearchResults`.
- Design authority: `"The cover fills the card, title and proof line stand on a scrim at its foot; the action appears on hover and focus, and under the image on touch widths"` (`#21119` operator-selected `Full bleed` contract; echoed in `apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs:202-205`).

## The Fix

1. **`resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css` (plus plain-CSS theme build sync):**
   - Remove unscoped desktop `.neo-list-item.neo-selected` and mouse `:focus-within` expansion from the base card rule.
   - Under `@media (min-width: 601px) and (hover: hover)`:
     - Expand `.portal-example-more` on `.neo-list-item:hover` when the list is not in `.portal-examples-keyboard` mode.
     - Expand `.portal-example-more` on `.neo-list-item:is(:focus-visible, :has(:focus-visible))` when `.portal-examples-keyboard` is active or no card in the list is `:hover` (`&:not(:has(.neo-list-item:hover))`), guaranteeing at most `1` expanded card on desktop across click, hover, `Tab`, and `Arrow` keys.
   - Under `@media (max-width: 600px), (hover: none)`:
     - Keep `.neo-list-item.neo-selected` and `.neo-list-item:focus-within` expanding `.portal-example-more` (with `max-width: 600px` opening under the 16:9 cover as today).
2. **`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs`:**
   - Add `keydown` (`ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Tab`) and delegated `.neo-list-item` `mouseenter` handling on `Portal.view.examples.List` to toggle `'portal-examples-keyboard'` on `cls` so Arrow-key navigation cleanly overrides a stationary pointer hover and moving the pointer onto a card hands control back to `:hover` (clearing any stale selection).
   - Guard card selection so clicks on `<a>` links (`neo-title`, `portal-example-open-cue`, `neo-github-image`) do not latch `.neo-selected`, and tapping an already-selected card body toggles it closed.
3. **Whitebox E2E Verification (`test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`):**
   - Add real-browser assertions verifying: (a) clicking Card A (`Sprint Board`) then hovering Card B (`Community Garden Plan`) leaves only Card B expanded (`1` open), and moving the mouse to `(0, 0)` leaves `0` open; (b) keyboard-focusing Card A then hovering Card B leaves only Card B (`1` open); (c) keeping the mouse stationary over Card B and pressing `ArrowRight`/`Tab` to Card C leaves only Card C (`1` open); and (d) hovering a `[Multi-window]` badge then moving the pointer to `(5, 5)` dismisses `.neo-tooltip`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **`AC-1` (No Stuck Card After Desktop Click):** Clicking an example card or its launch/source links on desktop (`1440×900`) does not latch `.portal-example-more` open once the pointer leaves the card or moves to another card (`0` open at `(0, 0)`, `1` open when hovering a sibling card).
- [ ] **`AC-2` (Single-Card Mutual Exclusion Across Hover & Keyboard Focus):** Hovering Card B while Card A holds keyboard focus expands only Card B (`1` open), and pressing `Arrow` / `Tab` keys while the pointer rests over Card B expands only the keyboard-focused card (`1` open).
- [ ] **`AC-3` (Touch / Narrow Phone Toggle & Link Cleanliness):** On `390×844` / touch, tapping a card body opens its details under the cover (`1` open), tapping a second card switches to that card (`1` open), tapping the open card again closes it (`0` open), and tapping `Open live ↗` or the title link launches without leaving a stale `.neo-selected` card.
- [ ] **`AC-4` (Theme Build & Whitebox E2E):** `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` and `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs` pass with explicit multi-modality regression coverage.

## Out of Scope

- Desktop resting caption line-clamp and opaque scrim token changes (`#21584` / PR `#21585` — disjoint lines in `List.css`).
- Phone first-screen header/intro height (`#21598`, `#21591`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Using `:focus-within` unconditionally on desktop:** Matches mouse clicks on `<li tabindex="-1">` and `<a>`, leaving clicked cards open after pointer departure even without `.neo-selected`.
- **Pure CSS `:not(:has(.neo-list-item:hover))` without keyboard-modality handoff:** Leaves a card under a stationary cursor stuck open while the user navigates elsewhere with Arrow keys.

### @neo-gemini-julia - 2026-11-20T21:30:23Z

Closing `#21606` as `NOT_PLANNED` following `@tobiu`'s architectural & UX veto on #21609:

- Suppressing desktop selection treated a symptom of collapsing `:hover` and `.neo-selected` onto the same `~80%` opaque black drawer (`List.css:79, 158-174`).
- `Portal.view.examples.List` needs **both** states (`Hovered` blue gradient blend, `Selected` green gradient blend, and `Hovered + Selected` composite blend as in `6fea520d4d:resources/scss/src/apps/portal/examples/List.scss:1-47`), a **stationary `Open live ↗` hitbox** that never moves away from the cursor on hover/select, cover-first visibility, and removal of the zero-entropy `"Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari"` browser list (`0/126` overrides in `examples.json`).
